articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Reasoning and Tool Use Improvements
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude 4, featuring significantly improved extended thinking capabilities and more reliable agentic tool use across complex multi-step tasks. The model reportedly scores new highs on coding and scientific reasoning benchmarks, outperforming competitors in several categories. The release includes a new API tier designed specifically for autonomous agent deployments.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2.5 Achieves Breakthrough in Video Understanding
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2.5 can now process and reason over full-length feature films with near-perfect recall, marking a major milestone in long-context multimodal AI. The model demonstrated the ability to answer nuanced plot and visual detail questions across two-hour videos in internal benchmarks. Researchers say the advancement opens new doors for medical imaging analysis and autonomous vehicle scene comprehension.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Dramatically Reduced Latency for Real-Time Apps
articles.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-5 Turbo, a distilled variant of its flagship model optimized for sub-200ms response times in production environments. The company claims the model retains 95% of GPT-5's capability while cutting inference costs by 60%, making it viable for real-time voice and coding assistant applications. Early enterprise adopters including Salesforce and SAP have already integrated the model into their platforms.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fines Over Non-Compliant AI Systems
articles.summary: The European AI Office has levied fines totaling €340 million against three technology firms for deploying high-risk AI systems without proper conformity assessments under the EU AI Act. This marks the first significant enforcement action since the Act's full provisions came into force earlier this year. Legal experts say the decisions signal that regulators are moving beyond guidance into active compliance enforcement.

articles.title: Meta Introduces RAG-Native Architecture in Llama 4 Scout for Enterprise Search
articles.summary: Meta has unveiled a retrieval-augmented generation-native version of its Llama 4 Scout model, built from the ground up to integrate with vector databases and enterprise knowledge bases. Unlike bolt-on RAG pipelines, the architecture embeds retrieval signals directly into the attention mechanism, reducing hallucination rates on knowledge-intensive tasks by an reported 40%. The model is being released under Meta's open-weight license with optimized connectors for popular data platforms.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Emerging Risks in Autonomous AI Agent Networks
articles.summary: A new report from Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute has outlined systemic safety risks arising from networks of autonomous AI agents that coordinate without consistent human oversight. The researchers documented several real-world incidents where multi-agent systems produced cascading errors in financial and logistics workflows. The report calls for mandatory circuit-breaker mechanisms and inter-agent communication auditing standards.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Adds Autonomous Workflow Builder with Natural Language Orchestration
articles.summary: Microsoft has significantly upgraded Copilot Studio with a new autonomous workflow builder that lets enterprise users design complex multi-agent pipelines using plain English descriptions. The tool automatically selects and configures sub-agents, assigns tools, and sets escalation policies without requiring code. The feature is rolling out to Microsoft 365 enterprise subscribers and integrates natively with Azure AI Foundry.

articles.title: Mistral AI Releases Mistral 3B Edge Model Optimized for On-Device Inference
articles.summary: Paris-based Mistral AI has launched a 3-billion parameter model specifically engineered for on-device deployment on smartphones and IoT hardware, claiming best-in-class performance for its size tier. The model runs fully offline on recent flagship Android and iOS devices, enabling private, low-latency AI features without cloud dependency. Mistral says several hardware partners including Qualcomm and Samsung will ship devices with the model pre-integrated later this year.
